exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithful subtle HD refinement of an existing painted game diffuse texture, not a photograph or object render.

Input: the sole opaqueRGB guide contains the ENTIRE original source canvas nearest-resized to512 width. Keep entire framing and normalized UV, every source shape/count/phase/shadow gap, material pattern scale and original faint local intensity hierarchy. No crop/zoom/border/padding or repositioned part.

Native128x64, guide512x256. Preserve the left olive gasmask silhouette/rectangular dark window/existing small round fields/upper notches and little right-side gray paint detail. Right field has exactly FOUR source narrow dark vertical seams at native x93,104,114,124; keep unequal original spacing and light seam edges. Do not turn these into extra rods/ribs or larger beveled grooves. No new vents, circles, screws, text or tube details.

Material: fine original matte painted olive/brown/gray palette. Add only very subtle fine paint detail within existing appearance, with original soft edge/source texture scale and broad shading. Keep small existing pale paint dim and flat; do not strengthen highlights into white raised hardware, bright bevel/rim, gloss or etched metal. No new grain/weave/creases/fibers/stripes or photorealistic material. Keep all UV shadows and existing black RGB as original color, not new holes.

Output: complete opaque storedRGB canvas matching reference aspect. Engine restores full original native alpha separately. No newly invented letters, numbers, logos, symbols, straps, seams, hardware or parts. Preserve exact original counts/positions and local brightness relationships; no decorative curl, new geometry or object perspective.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST4x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
